claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: Through the third quarter, we've delivered 161 commercial aircraft, the most since 2018.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: We received FAA certification for the 737-7 in July and the 737-10 just last week.
claims.matched_text: During the quarter, the 737-7 received amended type certification from the Federal Aviation Administration, and the 737-10 received certification in October.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: We reached a new four-year agreement with the union representing our engineering and technical workforce in the Pacific Northwest, avoiding any work interruption.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: And we scored a generational win with the U.S. Navy when they selected Boeing to design, build, and deliver its sixth-generation fighter jet, making Boeing the exclusive sixth-generation fighter company for both the U.S. Air Force and the U.S. Navy.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: The FAA certification of the 737-7 and the dash 10 represents the culmination of nearly 1,500 test flights and more than 4,000 hours of ground and flight testing.
claims.value: nearly 1,500 test flights; more than 4,000 hours

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: We continue to make progress on flight testing and still need approval to begin the balance of the flight test program, including ETOPS testing.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: We continue to expect first delivery in 2027, and all of our latest assumptions continue to be within the EAC we reset last year.
claims.matched_text: The company continues to anticipate certification in 2026 and first delivery in 2027 for both variants.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: Our factory key performance indicators are performing well, particularly in the final assembly where we've seen a 40% improvement in rework since the start of last year.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: However, as I mentioned at a conference last month, it is taking us longer than we had expected to demonstrate performance at rate 47.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: And I'm expecting it'll take us into next year to get fully stable at this rate.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: Taken together and integrating our learning from this year, our financial plan will target rate 52 in the back half of 2027.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: Switching now to 787, we are stable at eight aircraft per month while the factory is performing well.
claims.matched_text: The 787 program remains stable at a production rate of 8 per month.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: While we have stability in our factory, delivery cadence has been uneven month to month due to the seat certification challenges we've discussed previously.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: We still expect to start the transition to 10 per month yet this year, and we're making good progress on our Charleston expansion to support even higher production rates.

claims.speaker: Management
claims.quote: Last month, we achieved a transformational win that'll shape the company for decades to come when the U.S. Navy selected Boeing as the winner of the FAXX competition.
claims.matched_text: Selected by the U.S. Navy to design, build and deliver the F/A-XX next generation fighter aircraft
